_comment: Extended curated registry: historical editions (for the Temporal Standards Engine), withdrawn/merged standards, test-method standards with proper titles, and foreign standards used only by the Standards Equivalence engine. Curated for demonstration from public BIS catalogue information; dates marked approximate must be verified on standards.bis.gov.in before use in a live procurement.

standards.title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement (Third Revision)
standards.scope: Earlier edition covering Fe 415, Fe 500 and Fe 550 deformed bars. Superseded by the 2008 (Fourth Revision) which introduced ductile D grades.

standards.title: Ordinary Portland Cement — Specification (Fifth Revision)
standards.scope: Earlier edition of the consolidated OPC specification.

standards.title: 43 Grade Ordinary Portland Cement — Specification (First Revision)
standards.scope: Requirements of 43 grade ordinary Portland cement.

standards.title: Ordinary Portland Cement, 43 Grade — Specification (Second Revision)
standards.scope: Withdrawn: 43 grade OPC requirements were merged into IS 269:2015 (Sixth Revision) as '43 grade'.

standards.title: Ordinary Portland Cement, 53 Grade — Specification (First Revision)
standards.scope: Withdrawn: 53 grade OPC requirements were merged into IS 269:2015 as '53 grade'.

standards.title: Solar Flat Plate Collector — Specification
standards.scope: Requirements and test methods for solar flat plate collectors.

standards.title: Methods of Physical Tests for Hydraulic Cement — Part 1: Determination of Fineness by Dry Sieving
standards.scope: Test method: fineness of cement by dry sieving.

standards.title: Methods of Physical Tests for Hydraulic Cement — Part 2: Determination of Fineness by Specific Surface by Blaine Air Permeability Method
standards.scope: Test method: Blaine specific surface (m2/kg).

standards.title: Methods of Physical Tests for Hydraulic Cement — Part 3: Determination of Soundness
standards.scope: Test method: Le Chatelier and autoclave soundness.

standards.title: Methods of Physical Tests for Hydraulic Cement — Part 5: Determination of Initial and Final Setting Times
standards.scope: Test method: Vicat setting times.

standards.title: Methods of Physical Tests for Hydraulic Cement — Part 6: Determination of Compressive Strength of Hydraulic Cement other than Masonry Cement
standards.scope: Test method: compressive strength of mortar cubes at 3, 7 and 28 days.

standards.title: Method of Chemical Analysis of Hydraulic Cement
standards.scope: Chemical analysis methods for hydraulic cement.

standards.title: Metallic Materials — Tensile Testing — Part 1: Method of Test at Room Temperature
standards.scope: Tensile test: proof stress, tensile strength, elongation, Agt.

standards.title: Metallic Materials — Bend Test
standards.scope: Bend test of metallic materials.

standards.title: Methods for Chemical Analysis of Steels
standards.scope: Chemical analysis of plain and low alloy steels (C, S, P, Mn, Si ...).

standards.title: Ductile Design and Detailing of Reinforced Concrete Structures Subjected to Seismic Forces — Code of Practice
standards.scope: Ductile detailing requirements for RC structures in seismic zones III, IV and V.

standards.title: Code of Practice for Bending and Fixing of Bars for Concrete Reinforcement
standards.scope: Bending, cutting and fixing of reinforcement bars.

standards.title: Sampling Inspection Procedures — Part 1: Attribute Sampling Plans Indexed by Acceptable Quality Level (AQL) for Lot-by-Lot Inspection
standards.scope: Acceptance sampling plans for lot-by-lot inspection.

standards.title: Methods of Test for Cables — Part 5: Conductor Resistance Test
standards.scope: Conductor resistance test.

standards.title: Methods of Test for Cables — Part 43: Insulation Resistance
standards.scope: Insulation resistance test.

standards.title: Methods of Sampling and Test (Physical and Chemical) for Water and Wastewater — Part 11: pH Value
standards.scope: pH measurement.

standards.title: Methods of Sampling and Test (Physical and Chemical) for Water and Wastewater — Part 16: Filterable Residue (Total Dissolved Solids)
standards.scope: TDS measurement.

standards.title: Methods of Sampling and Test (Physical and Chemical) for Water and Wastewater — Part 21: Hardness
standards.scope: Total hardness measurement.

standards.title: Degrees of Protection Provided by Enclosures (IP Code)
standards.scope: Classification of degrees of protection (IP code) and tests.

standards.title: Method of Electrical and Photometric Measurements of Solid-State Lighting (LED) Products
standards.scope: Electrical and photometric measurement methods for LED products (efficacy, power, power factor).

standards.title: Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) — Testing and Measurement Techniques — Surge Immunity Test
standards.scope: Surge immunity test method (adoption of IEC 61000-4-5).

standards.title: Steel for the Reinforcement of Concrete — Weldable Reinforcing Steel — Bar, Coil and Decoiled Product (Foreign standard — equivalence analysis only)
standards.scope: Weldable ribbed reinforcing steel grades B500A, B500B, B500C.

standards.title: Deformed and Plain Carbon-Steel Bars for Concrete Reinforcement (Foreign standard — equivalence analysis only)
standards.scope: Deformed and plain carbon-steel bars for concrete reinforcement.

standards.title: Cement — Part 1: Composition, Specifications and Conformity Criteria for Common Cements (Foreign standard — equivalence analysis only)
standards.scope: Common cements CEM I-V, strength classes 32.5/42.5/52.5.

standards.title: Standard Specification for Portland Cement (Foreign standard — equivalence analysis only)
standards.scope: Portland cement Types I-V.

standards.title: Self-Ballasted LED Lamps for General Lighting Services — Part 1: Safety Requirements
standards.scope: Safety and interchangeability requirements for self-ballasted LED lamps (B22d/E27 caps). Concurrent running with the 2026 revision ended 02-08-2026, after which this edition is withdrawn.

standards.title: Self-Ballasted LED Lamps for General Lighting Services — Part 1: Safety Requirements (Revision)
standards.scope: Revised safety requirements for self-ballasted LED lamps; implementation guidelines issued by BIS (CRS) 24-02-2026 with concurrent running of the 2012 edition up to 02-08-2026.

standards.title: Self-Ballasted LED Lamps for General Lighting Services — Part 2: Performance Requirements
standards.scope: Performance requirements (luminous flux, efficacy, colour, lumen maintenance, power factor) of self-ballasted LED lamps. Edition year curated — verify on standards.bis.gov.in.

standards.title: Luminaires — Part 5: Particular Requirements — Section 3: Luminaires for Road and Street Lighting
standards.scope: Particular requirements for luminaires for road and street lighting, including LED street lights (registered under CRS).

standards.title: Luminaires — Part 1: General Requirements and Tests
standards.scope: General safety requirements and tests for luminaires.

standards.title: Conductors for Insulated Electric Cables and Flexible Cords
standards.scope: Classes of conductors (solid, stranded, flexible) and their maximum resistance.

standards.title: Methods of Test for Cables — Part 58: Oxygen Index Test
standards.scope: Oxygen index test for cable insulation and sheath.

standards.title: Electric Ceiling Type Fans — Specification (Fourth Revision)
standards.scope: Electric ceiling type fans for AC single-phase supply including sweep, air delivery, service value and safety. Mandatory under the Electric Ceiling Type Fans (Quality Control) Order, 2023.

standards.title: Electrical Accessories — Circuit Breakers for Overcurrent Protection for Household and Similar Installations — Part 1: Circuit Breakers for AC Operation
standards.scope: AC miniature circuit breakers (MCBs) up to 125 A and 25 kA breaking capacity. Replaces IS 8828 for MCB certification (verify amendment status).

standards.title: Terrestrial Photovoltaic (PV) Modules — Design Qualification and Type Approval — Part 1: Test Requirements — Section 1: Special Requirements for Testing of Crystalline Silicon PV Modules (Second Revision)
standards.scope: Withdrawn 18-05-2024.

standards.title: Terrestrial Photovoltaic (PV) Modules — Design Qualification and Type Approval — Part 1: Test Requirements — Section 1: Special Requirements for Testing of Crystalline Silicon PV Modules (Third Revision) / IEC 61215-1-1:2021
standards.scope: Design qualification of crystalline silicon PV modules; established 18-05-2023.

standards.title: Terrestrial Photovoltaic (PV) Modules — Design Qualification and Type Approval — Part 2: Test Procedures (Third Revision) / IEC 61215-2:2021
standards.scope: Test procedures for PV module design qualification.

standards.title: Photovoltaic (PV) Module Safety Qualification — Part 1: Requirements for Construction
standards.scope: Concurrent running with the 2023 edition up to 15-02-2027.

standards.title: Photovoltaic (PV) Module Safety Qualification — Part 1: Requirements for Construction
standards.scope: PV module safety — construction requirements (2023 edition). Adoption date approximate.

standards.title: Photovoltaic (PV) Module Safety Qualification — Part 2: Requirements for Testing
standards.scope: PV module safety — testing requirements (2023 edition). Adoption date approximate.
